questions.q: What myth does the author want to debunk in the video?
o: That you need to eat 6 times a day
That preparing food for the week takes a lot of time, is inconvenient and expensive
questions.e: In the video: "razbijemo mit da priprema obroka za celu nedelju oduzima mnogo vremena, da nije zgodno, da je skupo" — let's break the myth that preparing meals for the whole week takes a lot of time, that it's inconvenient, that it's expensive.

questions.q: Where do they buy meat and vegetables?
questions.e: In the video: "Ići ćemo sad na pijacu da pokupimo meso i povrće" — we'll now go to the market to pick up meat and vegetables.

questions.q: What meat is the focus of the video?
questions.e: In the video: "kilo ćuretine i kilo ramsteka, to je u fokusu" — a kilo of turkey and a kilo of rump steak, that's the focus.

questions.q: How much does a kilogram of sweet potato cost at the market?
questions.e: In the video: "ovaj slatki krompir od 440 dinara... 440 dinara kilo" — this sweet potato for 440 dinars... 440 dinars a kilo.

questions.q: Why does the author make a frittata rather than scrambled eggs?
o: A frittata keeps in the fridge and can be eaten cold or warm
questions.e: In the video: "Ako napraviš kajganu da te čeka za sutra... Ali ako napraviš fritatu... može da stoji u frižideru, može da se jede hladna, može da se jede topla" — if you make scrambled eggs to wait for you until tomorrow... But if you make a frittata... it can sit in the fridge, it can be eaten cold, it can be eaten warm.

questions.q: How long does the sweet potato take to cook?
questions.e: In the video: "batat je gotov, njemu treba pet minuta da se skuva" — the sweet potato is done, it takes five minutes to cook.

questions.q: How do you check that the frittata is done?
o: Pierce it: if no raw egg runs out, it's done
questions.e: In the video: "Bukvalno samo ubodeš i ako vidiš da ne izađe da vise jaja sa nje, to znači da je gotovo" — you literally just poke it, and if you see that no more egg comes out of it, it means it's done.

questions.q: How long does it take in the morning to prepare food for the day?
questions.e: In the video: "tu celu pripremu za ceo dan na recimo 10-15 minuta." — the whole preparation for the whole day in, say, 10–15 minutes.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Pirinač se kuva *odokativnom* metodom.
questions.e: Odokativno — by eye, without measuring.

questions.q: Kad je pirinač lepo kuvan, ti onda *procediš* to.
o: you will drain in a colander
questions.e: Procediti — to strain, to drain.

questions.q: Stalno savetujem da se *narenda* šargarepa i kupus.
questions.e: Narendati — to grate; renda — a grater.

questions.q: Jaja su žuća ako im se stavi *kurkuma*.
questions.e: Kurkuma — turmeric.

questions.q: Meso se *zapeklo* sa svih strana.
questions.e: Zapeći — to bake, to brown to a crust.

questions.q: Ovu ćuretinu sam *marinirao*.
questions.e: Marinirati — to marinate.

questions.q: Ovom *pretpripremom* možeš da uštediš mnogo vremena.
questions.e: Pretpriprema — advance preparation.

questions.q: Ako *sređuješ* sam, najbolje je da odmah prioneš poslu.
questions.e: Srediti — to put in order.

questions.q: Ići ćemo na ___ da pokupimo meso i povrće.
questions.e: Ići na + accusative case: na pijacu.

questions.q: ___ sam 8 jaja, to može da bude za danas i sutra.
questions.e: The result is eggs broken: perfective slomiti. Lomio is imperfective. A man is speaking.

questions.q: Kupio sam i angus burgere, tako da ono, to je ___ vama u suštini.
questions.e: Na vama je means "it's up to you" (set phrase): na + locative.

questions.q: nemojte da se plašite da ga ___ i 5 sati na sobnoj temperaturi.
questions.e: After da a single action takes the perfective: ostavite. Ostavljate is imperfective (habit).

questions.q: Meso treba ostaviti malo na sobnoj ___.
questions.e: Na in answer to "at what?" — locative case: na sobnoj temperaturi.

questions.q: Fritata se peče u ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where?" — locative case: u rerni.

questions.q: Ja ću da premažem meso ___.
questions.e: Premazati with what — instrumental case: senfom.

questions.q: Stavim na njega maslinovo ___.
questions.e: Staviti what — accusative case; for neuter nouns it coincides with the nominative: ulje.
